# Repository advisory lock key derived from slug

Advisory lock keys are computed deterministically from the repository slug using a 32-bit CRC32 (zlib.crc32) so the lock can be acquired before any database row for the repository exists.

Provide a stable per-repository lock identity independent of database row IDs so compilation/serialization can be enforced prior to persistence.
